trades.name: Failed reclaim of Friday's spike base 6412.5-6416
trades.quote: Any failure to reclaim Friday’s spike base (6412.5-6416 range) favors sellers enough that I am willing to be short looking for a retest and break of Friday’s low. It does always feel a bit like “shorting the hole” in these situations so I’ll rate it a B- but it is objectively a short below the spike base and certainly Friday’s low with the caveat about increasing potential for a cover rally from above.

Keep in mind this could include coming from much higher and if there is strong supportive session information I’ll consider entering directly within the 41-49 range or near 51-54 (think some kind of trend reversal into a lower high or multi-period box to work against as an example).
